meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在代理容器里安装 Vercel CLI,并让 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭据。此后代理可直接把网页应用部署到 Vercel,并运行部署、列出部署、查看身份等命令。
howto.when: 当你希望代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel,或运行 /add-vercel 时触发。前提是 OneCLI 已初始化,否则会先让你运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 把这个网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
列出我 Vercel 账号下最近的部署。
运行 /add-vercel,给代理加上 Vercel 部署能力。
say.note: 会安装 CLI 并配置你的 token

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials. Agents can then deploy web apps to Vercel and run commands like deploy, ls, and whoami.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel, or when you run /add-vercel. OneCLI must be initialized first; otherwise you are asked to run /init-onecli.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production.
Run /add-vercel to add Vercel deployment to the agent.
say_en.note: Installs the CLI and sets up the token
